top_signal.title: How do you keep track of quotes that go quiet? (Honest question)
top_signal.summary: I help run my family’s electrical contracting business. We send a lot of quotes by email and I’ve noticed the same thing: most customers who don’t reply aren’t saying no, they’re just busy, and then we forget to follow up.   For those of you who send quotes or invoices: what do you actually do? Notebook, spreadsheet, CRM, memory? How many quotes do you think slip through in a typical month?   I’m a developer too and I’m exploring this problem. Not selling anything, I just want to hear how people really handle it, including “I don’t have a problem with this” 🙂       submitted by     /u/aloiszitler       [link]       [comments]
